evaluation: test images from AI tools it never saw (scored once; Smaug is pretrained, so it is simply scored)
unclear_rule: the answer may only be real if neither our CLIP model nor Smaug says AI (>= 0.5); otherwise unclear. Chosen on 25 Nov from two live test images (an AI doodle the combiner called real, and an AI image our CLIP model called real), not from the test folder. The test folder has now been scored three times: no rule (results/fullsize_pilot_before_unclear_rule.json), unclear whenever CLIP and Smaug disagree (results/fullsize_pilot_disagree_rule.json), and this rule (this file).
note: Our models were trained on the training folder only; every AI tool in the test folder is missing from the training folder. Smaug's card lists several of these tools among its training generators, so its score here is not an unseen-tool result and can be too good.
